appDesc.message: Enhance Gemini UI - wider chat layout, scroll-to-bottom, Enter=newline, Ctrl+Enter=send, Ctrl+C=stop

widthLabel.description: Popup label for the chat width setting

saved.description: Popup status shown after the setting is saved

scrollToBottom.description: Tooltip of the scroll-to-bottom button on Gemini

featuresLabel.description: Popup heading for the feature on/off toggles

featureEnterNewline.description: Popup toggle: Enter key inserts a newline instead of sending

featureCmdEnterSend.description: Popup toggle: Cmd+Enter also sends the prompt (macOS)

featureCtrlCStop.description: Popup toggle: Ctrl+C stops response generation

featureScrollButton.description: Popup toggle: show the scroll-to-bottom button
